title: Replace Vite production dashboard build with Bun.build
description: Replace the Vite production dashboard build with Bun.build while preserving generated client assets, React JSX handling, static asset layout, the dashboard:build script contract, and binary asset embedding. Deliberately decide whether Vite remains solely for development watch/HMR or can be removed.
acceptance: dashboard:build produces the asset layout expected by productionDashboardDir and compiled binary tests.
Bun.build handles React entry points, CSS, asset hashing, and SPA fallback inputs used by the dashboard.
Vite and its React plugin are removed only if an equivalent supported development workflow is demonstrated; otherwise their retained development-only role is documented.
Bun 1.4 frozen install, tests, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass.
notes: See docs/bun-native-stack-migration-plan.md. This task precedes the native dashboard router migration to keep production client distribution stable.
